items.caption: This instance combines several thermostats into one room: one setpoint, one operating mode, one battery value. Values are set on each member individually — so this also works for thermostats that are not coupled in the manufacturer's app at all.
The devices do have groups of their own, but their data format is not confirmed. The route via the individual device instances is proven and also applies where switching to manual mode is configured.

If the members do not agree on the setpoint, the room shows the highest value and sets "Members disagree". An average would be wrong: 20 and 24 do not make a room at 22, but a room with two different targets.

items.caption: Thermostats of this room
➕  Add devices from the same device group
Adds all thermostats that, according to the device, belong to the same group as the ones already selected. The suggestion still has to be confirmed with "Apply".

items.caption: Current temperature of the room
For heating, the minimum value is the more honest figure — it is the coldest corner of the room.

items.name: SetpointMax
items.caption: Maximum
The device's scale runs from "Off" (7.5) through 8.0–28.0 °C up to "On" (28.5). The end stops are not temperatures but valve fully closed or fully open.

items.name: ClockWarnMinutes
items.caption: Report device clock from a deviation of
The largest deviation among the members is reported. The weekly schedule runs in the thermostat — if its clock is wrong, every switching point is shifted by the same amount.
This instance draws the same tile as the room tile of a single thermostat — dial, fine steps, quick select and operating mode. A room should be operated like a single device.

After a module update, Symcon does not always apply an instance's settings by itself. The only other way is to change something in the form and change it back — only then does "Apply" become clickable at all. This button saves you that.
⚠️  Acts on the saved settings. Anything you changed above but have not applied yet is lost.
This is harmless for the devices: applying sends nothing and therefore does not wake any battery.
🔄  Force apply (without a form change)
